title: Discord
lyrics:
[00:09.49]I'm not a fan of puppeteers, but I've a nagging fear
[00:12.20]Someone else is pulling at the strings
[00:14.02]Something terrible is going down through the entire town
[00:16.77]Wreaking anarchy and all it brings
[00:18.68]I can't sit idly, no, I can't move at all
[00:22.68]I curse the name, the one behind it all
[00:27.49]Discord, I'm howlin' at the moon
[00:29.64]And sleeping in the middle of a summer afternoon
[00:32.06]Discord, whatever did we do
[00:34.22]To make you take our world away?
[00:36.62]Discord, are we your prey alone
[00:38.78]Or are we just a stepping stone for taking back the throne?
[00:41.20]Discord, we won't take it anymore
[00:43.34]So take your tyranny away
